verdict.line: You lose if you trade into a full Riven combo with your W down; you win every duel from level 6 on if you force it with your own cooldowns up.

brief.thesis: This is a cooldown-timing matchup, not a stat check — the 335-game sample sits at 49.3% because both champions win off the same mistake: fighting into an enemy resource that's live instead of one that's down. Riven's all-in requires Ki Burst (W) and a dash chain to be up; Mordekaiser's answer is Indestructible (W) absorbing that burst and, from level 6, Realm of Death removing her escape entirely. Solo-kill advantage sits with Mordekaiser because once he traps her in Realm of Death she has no ally to save her — the duel is 1v1 on his terms.

theirWindow.what: Riven can chain Q (Broken Wings) into W (Ki Burst) for a stun, then finish the third Q reactivation with empowered Runic Blade autos while you have no shield to offset it. Disengage to minion range and let Indestructible's 12/11/10/9/8s cooldown reset before you trade again.

yourWindow.when: after Riven E's away to clear casters
yourWindow.what: With Valor's 10/9/8/7/6s cooldown burning, she can't block magic damage or reposition — hit her with E (Death's Grasp) to pull her back into range, then Q (Obliterate) for the single-target damage bonus. From level 6, land R (Realm of Death) instead to remove her escape completely.

start.why: Measured at 52.9% WR over 70 games and mechanically correct here — the physical damage reduction and regen blunt Riven's early empowered autos while you wait for Indestructible to come off cooldown between trades.

boots.why: 89.4% pick rate at 48% WR — the flat AA damage reduction directly cuts the empowered autos her Runic Blade passive is built around.

core.why: Slow on Q and E lets you land Death's Grasp's pull and then keep her inside Obliterate range instead of letting Valor carry her out.
Omnivamp sustains you through extended trades where her Ki Burst stun otherwise wins the fight on damage alone.
This exact path (Rylai's > Riftmaker > Liandry's) is the most-played build at 51.7% WR over 29 games and scales your DPS in prolonged skirmishes she can't dash away from.

situational.when: you're struggling to survive her early all-ins before your first full item spike, matching OP.GG's own read on this lane
she's ahead in kills and snowballing on auto-attack damage in the mid game
the game runs long and you need the extra utility it provides in extended fights

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks through the extended trades this matchup produces and converts to healing, which is what closes out fights she tries to stun-lock you out of.

summoners.why: Most-played at 68% pick and 47.4% WR — Ignite matches your measured solo-kill advantage by denying her Second Wind-style sustain during the level 6+ Realm of Death window.

playing.title: Rank Q first, E second
playing.detail: Obliterate's single-target bonus damage is your main trade tool; ranking E early gives you the pull to punish her Valor cooldown before level 6.

playing.title: Never extend without W up
playing.detail: Indestructible's stored shield is the only thing that offsets a full Ki Burst stun combo — if it's down, hold minion range instead of trading.

playing.title: Hold R for isolation, not chip
playing.detail: Realm of Death's 140/120/100/90/80s cooldown is too long to waste on poke; save it for a clean pull when her Valor is already spent.

playing.title: Track passive stacks in extended fights
playing.detail: Darkness Rise's damage aura and move speed come online after 3 landed attacks or spells — time your all-in to when it's active, not before.

playing.title: Punish her E on cooldown
playing.detail: The moment Valor goes on its 10/9/8/7/6s cooldown, she has no damage block and no dash — this is your highest-value E-into-Q window all lane.

playing.title: Don't trade through Ki Burst blind
playing.detail: Ki Burst's 11/10/9/8/7s cooldown is short late — if you can't see it on cooldown, assume it's up and don't walk into stun range.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, boots, starting items, runes, and summoner spells above are pulled directly from measured OP.GG data on the current patch (16.18.1) — the win rates and pick rates are fact. The timing reads, cooldown windows, and trade logic are my own analysis of how the two kits interact.

stats.opponentTip: Do not fight Riven if your [W] is on cooldown. Purchase Bramble Vest and maintain your [P] when fighting her.
